categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two primary business segments: (1) Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) and Touch Control Display Modules - including LCD screens, LCD display modules, capacitive touch screens, integrated touch-control display modules, protective screen cover glass, and related products; (2) Electromagnetic Wire - including copper and aluminum enameled wires, composite wires, and related products. These products are applied in automotive displays, home electronics, medical devices, industrial control, and power transmission sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs customized/made-to-order production models for touch-control display products, utilizing advanced manufacturing techniques for LCD and touch-screen integration. For electromagnetic wire production, the company uses specialized wire drawing, enameling, and transposition technologies. Core technologies include optical bonding, liquid crystal display driver design, and high-precision wire manufacturing processes. The company maintains R&D capabilities in emerging technologies such as ZBD (Zero Birefringence Display) dual-stable liquid crystal displays and advanced enameled wire production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global customers including Fortune 500 companies and industry leaders such as Walmart, Belkin, Midea Electronics, Flex, Jabil Circuit, Desay SV, Honeywell, and Yikoo Water Purification. Primary end markets include automotive display systems, home appliance electronics, medical equipment, industrial control systems, and power transmission infrastructure. Geographic markets span North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple geographic regions with manufacturing and sales presence in China (Tianjin, Hunan, Jiangsu, Guangdong), Malaysia, and the United States. Key operating locations include Tianjin headquarters, Hunan production facilities, Jiangsu semiconductor operations, and overseas subsidiaries in the United States and Hong Kong. International sales account for approximately 65% of total revenue, with significant presence in American and European markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Midstream for electromagnetic wire - manufacturing intermediate products from raw materials (copper/aluminum) for downstream industrial applications; (2) Downstream for touch-control displays - integrating components into finished display modules for original equipment manufacturers and system integrators. The company sources raw materials (copper, aluminum, integrated circuits, LCD panels, flexible circuits) and manufactures value-added products for industrial and consumer electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation and R&D investment (2.43% of revenue in 2024) focusing on: (1) Advanced display technologies including ZBD dual-stable liquid crystal displays, reflective displays with eye-protection features, and integrated touch-display solutions; (2) Next-generation electromagnetic wire products for renewable energy and high-voltage applications; (3) Semiconductor and chip design capabilities for display drivers; (4) Emerging applications in autonomous vehicle displays and smart home integration. The company is establishing semiconductor operations in Jiangsu province to expand into chip design and manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct product sales of manufactured goods. Revenue streams include: (1) Touch-control display module sales to OEMs and system integrators; (2) Electromagnetic wire sales to power equipment manufacturers and industrial customers; (3) LCD display and component sales. The company operates on a made-to-order basis with customer-specific customization, generating revenue upon product delivery and customer acceptance. No subscription, licensing, or advertising revenue models are employed.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the touch-control display sector, the company positions itself as a leading domestic manufacturer with comprehensive one-stop service capabilities. The company competes with other display module manufacturers through superior product quality, stable performance, and responsive customer service. In the electromagnetic wire sector, the company focuses on high-end products and maintains a leading position in China's mid-to-high-end market segment. The company differentiates through technical expertise, quality standards, and customer relationships rather than competing primarily on price.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 3.26 billion yuan, representing a 5% decline from 2023 (3.43 billion yuan). The company achieved profitability recovery in 2024 with net profit of 21.5 million yuan compared to a 289 million yuan loss in 2023. Total assets of 4.53 billion yuan reflect a stable asset base. The company demonstrates a recovery trajectory after 2023 challenges, with improving operational efficiency and positive cash flow generation (91.5 million yuan from operations in 2024).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes: (1) Comprehensive integrated solutions - providing complete touch-control display solutions from design to manufacturing, reducing customer integration complexity; (2) Superior product quality and performance - maintaining high manufacturing standards and stable product performance recognized by major global customers; (3) Responsive customer service - offering rapid response capabilities and customized solutions tailored to specific customer requirements; (4) Technical innovation - continuous development of advanced display technologies and manufacturing processes; (5) Cost-effectiveness - delivering competitive pricing through manufacturing efficiency while maintaining quality standards. The company's value proposition centers on being a reliable, technically capable, and responsive supplier of specialized display and electromagnetic wire products.
